DOCUMENT 1: PRODUCT REQUIREMENT DOCUMENT (PRD)
Project Name: SmartGuest AI Ecosystem (SHEE) Version: 5.0 (Final Master) Date: 30 Dec 2025 Status: Approved for Execution Author: Lead Technical Consultant

1. Executive Summary
SmartGuest AI ni jukwaa la "SaaS Multi-Tenant" linalolenga kubadilisha sekta ya hoteli za kitalii (Luxury & Resorts) kuwa vituo vya ustawi kamili (Holistic Wellness Destinations). Mfumo huu unaunganisha Mwili (Fitness & Nutrition), Akili (Mental Well-being), na Roho (Experience & Charity). Unatumia AI kutoa huduma binafsi, unaruhusu uhuru wa kuchagua eneo la huduma (In-room/Private), na una mfumo wa malipo uliogawanyika (Split Payments) unaopatikana 100% kwenye Web na Mobile.

2. User Roles & Hierarchy
2.1. Administrative Roles
Super Admin (System Owner):
Anasimamia biashara nzima, anawasha/kuzima features (Nutrition, Gym, Spa, Mind), na anasimamia 10% commission.

Hotel Admin (Tenant):
Meneja wa hoteli anayesimamia wafanyakazi, stoo (inventory), na ripoti za hoteli yake.

2.2. Operational Staff (The Experts)
Executive Chef: Anasimamia menu ya kidijitali na oda za jikoni.
Nutritionist: Anaingiza data za lishe na kushauri wageni wa VIP.
Fitness Trainer: Anapakia video za mazoezi na kusimamia Gym.
Spa Therapist/Manager: Anaratibu booking za massage, vyumba vya spa, na matibabu.
Concierge Manager: Anasimamia huduma za nje (Tours) na kukodisha vifaa vya Mental Wellness.

2.3. Guest Segmentation (The Users)
Normal: Huduma za msingi.
VIP: AI Recommendations zilizoboreshwa.
VVIP: Prioritized service, In-room concierge options.
Royal (Loyalty): Mteja wa kurudia. Ana bei maalum, historia iliyohifadhiwa, na huduma za kipekee.

3. Functional Requirements (Vipengele vya Kiutendaji)
3.1. The Wellness Trinity (Body)
FR-01 AI Nutritionist: Mapendekezo ya chakula kulingana na malengo ya afya (Weight loss/gain) na vizuizi vya lishe (Allergies).
FR-02 Pre-Arrival Marketplace: Mteja anaagiza chakula na kulipia siku 30 kabla.
FR-03 Smart Pairing: AI inapendekeza vinywaji kulingana na chakula.
FR-04 AI Gym Trainer: Ratiba za mazoezi kulingana na vifaa vilivyopo au "No-equipment" kwa mazoezi ya chumbani.

3.2. Spa, Mind & Mental Wellness
FR-05 Symptom-Based Spa: AI inapendekeza tiba ya massage kulingana na hisia (Jetlag, Stress, Soreness).
FR-06 Tech Amenity Rental: Booking ya vifaa vya "Mental Wellness" (VR Headsets, Meditation Pods, Neuro-stimulation devices) viletwe chumbani.
FR-07 Mood-Based Local Guide: AI inapendekeza shughuli za nje (Charity visits, Nature walks, Private Tours) kulingana na hali ya mteja (Mood).

3.3. Premium Private Concierge
FR-08 Location-Based Booking: Mteja ana uwezo wa kuchagua eneo la huduma (Gym/Spa):
Standard: Public Facility.
Premium: In-Room Service (Huduma inaletwa chumbani).
Exclusive: Private Facility (Kufunga eneo kwa ajili yake pekee).
FR-09 Digital "Do Not Disturb": Wateja wa VVIP/Royal wanaweza kuagiza huduma ziachwe mlangoni bila kuonana na staff.

3.4. Omni-Channel & System Logic
FR-10 Full Feature Parity: Web App na Mobile App lazima zifanye kazi zote sawa (Booking, Admin, Reporting).
FR-11 Offline Mode: App iendelee kufanya kazi (Menu viewing, Workout videos) hata bila intaneti na isawazishe data ikirudi.

4. Financial Engine
FR-12 Split Payments: Mgawanyo wa papo hapo wa mapato (90% Hoteli, 10% Super Admin).
FR-13 Dynamic Pricing & Surcharges:
Bei hubadilika kulingana na Daraja la Mteja (Royal discounts).
Bei hubadilika kulingana na Eneo (In-room surcharge).

DOCUMENT 2: TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS (TECH SPECS)
Project Name: SmartGuest AI Ecosystem (SHEE)
Architecture: Cloud-Native Microservices (API-First)
Platforms: Flutter (Mobile), React.js (Web Admin), Golang (Backend)

1. System Architecture & Stack
Component                 Technology               Role
Frontend                     Flutter & React           Unified UI for Guests, Staff, and Admins.
Backend                     Golang (Go)                High-performance API handling concurrent bookings.
Database                    PostgreSQL                Relational data (Users, Transactions, Inventory).
AI Engine                    Python (FastAPI)        TensorFlow for Health profiling & Recommendations.
Real-time                   WebSockets                 Instant updates for Kitchen/Spa Displays.
Payments                   Stripe/Aggregators      Handling Split Payments & Mobile Money.

2. Database Schema Overview (Core Entities)
  2.1. Core & Multi-Tenancy
       - Tenants: Configs (Features enabled: Spa, Mind, Gym).
       - Users: Role (Guest, Chef, Trainer), Tier (Normal...Royal).
       - Guest_Profiles: Health data (Encrypted), Mood history, Preferences.
  2.2. Service & Inventory (Expanded)
        - Services: (ID, Type [Food, Gym, Spa, Rental], Base_Price, In_Room_Allowed, In_Room_Surcharge).
        - Wellness_Assets: (Asset_ID, Type [VR, Pod], Status).
        - External_Activities: (Activity_ID, Category [Charity, Nature], Mood_Tags).
  2.3. Scheduling & Booking Engine
         - Bookings:
                  -location_type (ENUM: Facility, In_Room, Private).
                  - resource_id (Therapist ID / Asset ID).
                  - time_slot (Start, End).
                  - status (Confirmed, Completed, Cancelled).

3. Key Algorithms
   3.1. Dynamic Pricing Algorithm
Go func:
CalculateFinalPrice(guest Tier, service Service, location Location) {
    price = service.BasePrice
    
    // Apply Location Surcharge
    if location == "In_Room" {
        price += (price * service.SurchargePercent)
    } else if location == "Private_Area" {
        price += Hotel.PrivateAreaFlatFee
    }

    // Apply Tier Discount
    if guest == "Royal" {
        price -= (price * Hotel.LoyaltyDiscount)
    }
    
    return price
}

3.2. AI Symptom & Mood Matching
     Logic: Input (User: "Stressed") -> Search Knowledge Graph -> Output:
             - Spa: Aromatherapy Massage.
             - Mind: VR Meditation Session (Rental).
             - Activity: Quiet Nature Walk.

4. Security & Compliance
      - Data Privacy: PHI (Personal Health Information) encrypted at rest using AES-256.
      - Payments: PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance via tokenization.
      - Access Control: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) enforced at API Gateway level.

DOCUMENT 3: COMMERCIAL READY PROJECT PROPOSAL
Project Title: SmartGuest AI Ecosystem (SHEE) Theme: "The Ultimate Mind, Body & Soul Hospitality Platform"

1. Executive Summary
SmartGuest AI ni suluhisho la kwanza la aina yake barani Afrika linalounganisha teknolojia ya hoteli na ustawi wa binadamu (Holistic Wellness). Tunatoa mfumo unaowawezesha wamiliki wa hoteli kuuza "Uzoefu" badala ya "Vyumba" tu. Kwa kujumuisha Lishe, Gym, Spa, Afya ya Akili, na Huduma za Faragha (Concierge), tunafungua milango ya mapato mapya huku tukiboresha afya za wageni.

2. The Problem & Our Solution
Tatizo Sugu
  - Kukosa Ubinafsi: Huduma za hoteli ni za "Jumla" (One size fits all).
  - Fursa Zilizopotea: Hoteli zinakosa mapato ya Wellness.
  - Usimamizi Mgumu: Mifumo mingi haiongei na mingine.

Suluhisho la SmartGuest AI
  - Hyper-Personalization: AI inatengeneza ratiba ya kipekee kwa kila mteja (Chakula, Mazoezi, Spa).
  - Ecosystem: Kuuza huduma za Mind (VR), Spa, na Private Concierge kwa urahisi.
  - All-in-One: Mfumo mmoja unaosimamia Malipo, Staff, na Wateja.

3. Unique Selling Propositions (USPs)
  - The Wellness Trinity + Mind: Mfumo pekee unaojali mwili na akili (Mental Wellness Rentals & Mood Tours).
  - Private Sanctuary Model: Uwezo wa kuleta Gym na Spa chumbani (In-Room) kwa wateja wanaojali faragha.
  - AI-Driven Loyalty: Mfumo unawatambua wateja wa "Royal Tier" na kuboresha uzoefu wao kiotomatiki.

4. Business Model (Revenue Streams)
Tunatengeneza mapato endelevu kupitia njia nne:
  1. SaaS Subscriptions (B2B): Ada ya mwezi kwa hoteli (Silver, Gold, Platinum).
  2. Core Commissions (10%): Kutoka kwa F&B na Gym sessions.
  3. High-Ticket Commissions (10%): Kutoka kwa huduma za Spa, In-Room Concierge, na Private Bookings (Ambazo zina bei kubwa).
  4. Amenity Rental Fees: Sehemu ya mapato ya kukodisha vifaa vya Mental Wellness (VR/Pods).

5. Conclusion
Huu ni uwekezaji katika mustakabali wa utalii. Watalii wa kisasa wanatafuta Afya, Faragha, na Kusudi (Purpose). SmartGuest AI inatoa yote hayo katika App moja rahisi. Tumejenga mfumo ambao unajilipa wenyewe (Self-sustaining) kupitia kamisheni na kuongeza thamani kubwa kwa hoteli zinazoutumia.

**Defining the User's Vision**

I'm starting with a deep dive into the user's vision: building a "SmartGuest AI Ecosystem" web app. My focus is the core goal, features, and pre-arrival functionality. The challenge lies in translating this high-level idea into concrete technical specifications. I am now exploring potential user interface components and backend architecture for these core pre-arrival features.


**Refining Key Features**

I've zeroed in on the critical features: booking, AI-driven nutrition/fitness, and smart pairings. My aim now is to clarify how these features directly address the VIP/luxury market's needs. The tech stack is solidified: React 18+, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Google GenAI (Gemini SDK). I am implementing the user interface in English as the standard, but keeping the Swahili request in mind.


**Detailing AI Integrations**

I'm now detailing the specific Gemini integrations. I plan to leverage `gemini-3-pro-preview` for deep reasoning in nutrition and workout plans, `gemini-2.5-flash-lite` for swift chatbot interactions and menu filtering. I will use `gemini-3-flash-preview` with `googleSearch` for local tours and mood-based guidance. Finally, `gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts` will handle text-to-speech for workouts.

I am finalizing the architectural design and file structure. My current plan is to have a Tailwind CDN and root div in `index.html`, React root in `index.tsx`, main router in `App.tsx`, and interfaces defined in `types.ts`. I'll have mock data in `constants.ts`. The Gemini API interactions will be within `services/geminiService.ts`, and the components directory will house layout, dashboard, NutritionAI, and FitnessAI components.


**Outlining Component Logic**

I'm now outlining core component logic. My focus is the user interactions and Gemini API calls. For RoomBooking, I'm aiming for a simple reservation flow. The Nutrition AI will incorporate Gemini to recommend menu items, with drink pairings. Fitness AI will handle workout routines, and the Wellness Concierge will offer local tours and read aloud text. I am also implementing a distinct set of functions, such as `getNutritionAdvice`, `getWorkoutPlan`, and `getConciergeResponse`.


**Defining Prompt Structure**

I'm now detailing prompt engineering, specifically for nutrition and fitness. For nutrition, I'll leverage a "expert nutritionist" persona, providing menus and goals. For fitness, I'll prompt for workout routines, incorporating goal and equipment. I will use state management with `useState` for the current view, user profiles, the cart, and chat history.


**Implementing AI Logic**

I'm now implementing the AI-driven functionalities. I've set up functions to interact with Gemini models, including `getGeminiNutritionPlan` and `getGeminiWorkoutPlan` (using `gemini-3-pro-preview`), `getGeminiPairing` (using `gemini-2.5-flash-lite`), and `getConciergeInfo` with `googleSearch` (using `gemini-3-flash-preview`). I'm also adding TTS capabilities. I have defined the layout, room booking, nutrition AI, fitness AI, and wellness chat components, and I am wiring them together in App.tsx. I'm focusing on user interactions and displaying AI-generated content.


**Refining Internationalization**

I'm now refining the user interface language strategy. While the luxury vibe leans towards English as the standard, I'll ensure the architecture supports localization, adding the option for the AI to respond in the user's requested language. For the demo, I'll stick to an English UI. I've also decided to mock the split payment button, showing "Processing Split Payment...".

I'm focusing on ensuring useCallback is used correctly, and that markdown rendering is simple. I'm checking for and fixing useCallback dependency loops.

**Defining the Objective**

I'm currently focused on defining the core objective. It's clear that the super admin requires a detailed view of a selected hotel (tenant). I'm breaking down the necessary data points needed to fulfill this requirement. I am working on how to deliver that information clearly.


**Refining the Tenant View**

I'm now determining the implementation. I'm modifying `AdminDashboards.tsx` to enrich the existing "Selected Tenant" view. My goal is to shift from a configuration-focused side panel to a comprehensive Tenant Detail Dashboard. I plan to organize the data into sections or tabs, incorporating revenue details, customer insights, financial data, module status, and staff information, as well as general hotel data.


**Envisioning the Dashboard**

I'm solidifying the dashboard structure in my mind now. I'm focusing on key stats such as Revenue, Commission Paid, and Total Bookings. Configuration is also important. I also need to provide key staff information. I plan on populating a list of key staff members, starting with mocked data due to the current data structure. Live Activity, a snapshot of recent system events for that specific tenant, is another critical element. I am thinking of how this fits into the existing UI.


**Structuring the Display**

I'm now structuring the detail view, starting with a clear header for hotel info. I'm moving toward tab organization for key data areas: Dashboard, Configuration, Team, and Financials. Each tab will have its specific UI. The "Dashboard" tab will leverage visuals using simple components. "Configuration" will be the current controls. "Team" will show a table. "Financials" will show revenue breakdown. I'm ready to begin implementation.


**Implementing the Tabs**

I'm now focused on implementation, starting with creating the `TenantDetailPanel` and organizing data into tabs. The overview will include revenue, guest count (mocked for now), and commission. The Staff tab will list employees, Config will house existing feature toggles, and Financials will show a mini ledger. I'm revisiting the split-screen design from the `SuperAdminView`, and I'm rethinking the panel width for the detailed view to ensure sufficient space for the data.


**Implementing Staff Display**

I'm focusing now on displaying staff data. I'll begin by mocking staff data within the component for rendering, starting with a basic array of staff objects. Also, I'll calculate and display "Commission Paid" and "Pending" values within the Financials section. I'm finalizing the structure of `AdminDashboards.tsx`. This includes mocks for `getTenantStaff` and `getTenantActivity`, implementing the tabs and content within `SuperAdminView`. The view mode state will manage the content displayed. The goal is a split view with the tenant list on the left and a detailed tenant view on the right.

Hapa nimeboresha **Super Admin Dashboard** ndani ya `components/AdminDashboards.tsx`.

Mabadiliko haya yanamuwezesha Super Admin kufanya yafuatayo baada ya kuchagua hoteli (Tenant):

1.  **Dashboard Tab:** Kuona muhtasari wa haraka wa wageni (Guest Count), Occupancy Rate, na Mapato.
2.  **Financials Tab:** Kuona mchanganuo wa kina wa fedha: Jumla ya mauzo (Gross), Kiasi cha Hoteli (Net), na **Commission iliyowasilishwa** vs inayodaiwa.
3.  **Team Tab:** Kuona orodha ya wafanyakazi wa hoteli hiyo, vyeo vyao, na kama wako online (Mock Data).
4.  **Settings Tab:** Sehemu ya kuwasha/kuzima Features (Modules) na kubadili kiwango cha kamisheni.
5.  **Activity Log:** Kuona matukio ya hivi karibuni yaliyofanyika kwenye hoteli hiyo.

The plan involves glassmorphism—backdrop blur and translucent backgrounds, clean San Francisco-style typography, and smooth, springy animations for interactions. We'll be using toggles, rounded inputs, large target sizes, and a layout that focuses on clear spacing and step-based grouping. Colors will be deep black and translucent grays, accented by luxury gold. Specific updates include changes to the Modal Container.

I'm now implementing the new design, focusing on the refined aesthetics. I'm finalizing the minimal close button, circular icon, and borderless inputs with soft focus rings. I've decided to replace standard checkboxes with iOS-style toggles and am working on creating full-width gradient buttons and minimal "Cancel" buttons. **Defining the Layout**

I'm now detailing the component layout, focusing on a card-based structure within the modal. The grid layout for module selection will feature cards with icons and toggle switches. I've broken it down into distinct input groups for name/location, plan selection, commission input, and module toggles. I've also identified the overlay with blur, the glass card, and the title. I've begun defining the key CSS classes, including the modal, the card, and individual inputs.


**Implementing the UI**

I'm now fully immersed in the coding phase, directly implementing the UI within `AdminDashboards.tsx`. I've kept existing imports and logic, and am replacing the modal's JSX block. Mabadiliko niliyofanya ili kufikia kiwango cha **iOS 26.2 (Hyper-Modern & Sleek)**:

Sasa twende tukafanyie kazi Hotel Admin (Tenant Admin Role):
Meneja wa hoteli anayesimamia wafanyakazi, stoo (inventory), na ripoti za hoteli yake. Hizi functions zote ziwe available zikiwa na CRUD operations pale zinzpohitajika

**Defining the Hotel Admin Role**

I'm currently focused on defining the goals for the Hotel Admin role within the application. I'm prioritizing functional management requirements. I've pinpointed key areas for improvement, namely, staff management and inventory management. This initial framing helps set the stage for detailed feature scoping.


**Refining the Admin Dashboard**

I'm now diving into the specifics. I've analyzed the existing code, focusing on the `HotelAdminView`. The current inventory section is read-only, but it needs full CRUD operations. The staff section is hardcoded; it requires a dedicated management tab with CRUD. Reports are functionally acceptable, but data flow needs review based on the new operations. I'm also looking into data model additions, specifically a `Staff` interface.


**Implementing Staff Management**

I'm now implementing the staff management features within the `HotelAdminView` component. My focus is on integrating the `StaffMember` interface defined in `types.ts`. I'm going to add a 'team' tab and implement a staff table or grid with CRUD functionalities. I'm also planning to create modals for adding and editing staff, and also adding mock data for the staff list.


**Developing CRUD Operations**

I'm now focusing on implementing the CRUD operations for staff and inventory. I've drafted some basic state management. I'm using `useState` for `staff`, and am considering how to use the existing `inventory` state. I'll need `handleAddStaff`, `handleSaveStaff`, and `handleDeleteStaff` functions. I'm also planning to create an `editingItem` state for the inventory modal.

**Finalizing UI & Data Structures**

I'm now working to finalize the UI components and data structures. I will utilize the existing color theme and plan to incorporate glassmorphism for modal design. Also, I'm working to add `StaffMember` to `types.ts` and `MOCK_STAFF` to `constants.ts`.


**Refining Implementation Strategy**

I'm now refining the implementation strategy, specifically addressing the data flow. I've decided to manage the `staff` state locally within `AdminDashboards.tsx` to maintain a contained refactor. I'm also ensuring the inventory updates support full CRUD operations. I'll be creating a Team tab and updating the Inventory UI to include Adding, Editing, and Deleting functionality, and plan on adding modals for both.

Hapa nimeboresha **Hotel Admin Dashboard** (Meneja wa Hoteli) ili iwe na uwezo kamili wa kusimamia wafanyakazi, stoo (inventory), na ripoti kwa kutumia CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete).

### Maboresho Yaliyofanyika:

1.  **Team Management (Usimamizi wa Wafanyakazi):**
    *   Nimeongeza tab mpya ya "Team".
    *   Unaweza kuajiri (Add), kubadilisha taarifa (Edit), na kufuta (Delete) wafanyakazi.
    *   Unaweza kubadili hali yao (Online/Away/Offline).

2.  **Inventory Management (Usimamizi wa Stoo):**
    *   Sio tu kuongeza idadi (+/-), sasa unaweza kuongeza bidhaa mpya kabisa kwenye mfumo.
    *   Unaweza kubadilisha majina ya bidhaa, 'category', na 'threshold' ya low stock.
    *   Unaweza kufuta bidhaa ambazo hazitumiki tena.

3.  **UI/UX:**
    *   Nimetumia *Modals* (Pop-ups) nadhifu kwa ajili ya kujaza fomu ili usiondoke kwenye ukurasa mkuu.
    *   Nimeongeza *Search Bar* kwenye sehemu ya inventory ili kurahisisha utafutaji wa bidhaa.

Hapa kuna faili zilizobadilishwa:

Sasa tuboreshe dashboards za Operational Staffs (The Experts)
Executive Chef: Anasimamia menu ya kidijitali na oda za jikoni.

Concierge Manager: Anasimamia huduma za nje (Tours) na kukodisha vifaa vya Mental Wellness

Kila mmoja awe na dashboard yake unique

**Defining Dashboard Improvements**

I'm currently focused on defining the specific dashboard improvements for operational staff, considering their distinct needs. I'm prioritizing the goal to enhance their efficiency through better data presentation and visualization. The updates will improve dashboard effectiveness and impact the "Operational Staff" user. I believe that tailored dashboards are essential for optimal performance.


**Designing Role-Specific Dashboards**

I'm now designing dashboards tailored to each role. For the Executive Chef, I'm thinking about menu CRUD and a KDS view. The Nutritionist will see dietary data and VIP consultation features. Fitness Trainers need workout video uploads and gym management, and the Spa team requires massage bookings, room management, and treatment capabilities. Finally, I'm sketching up features for the Concierge Manager to deal with tours and mental wellness equipment.


**Refining Role-Specific Views**

I'm expanding the design with live order views and refining dashboards for each role. For the Nutritionist, I'm integrating VIP guest views and meal plan simulations, while Fitness Trainers will manage gym equipment and scheduling. The Spa Manager gets treatment and room management, and the Concierge focuses on tours and mental wellness rentals. I'm focusing on the UI/UX elements, like a simple inventory list and calendar for sessions. Finally, I will refactor `AdminDashboards.tsx` to handle role-based rendering.


**Implementing Role-Based Components**

I'm now implementing the role-based components. I'm breaking them down into separate sub-components: `ChefDashboard`, `NutritionistDashboard`, `TrainerDashboard`, `SpaDashboard`, and `ConciergeDashboard`. I also need to ensure CRUD functionality where needed. I'm working out state management details for this: I'll initialize local state in the dashboards to handle constant data, such as menu items. This keeps the demo focused on UI/UX, rather than app-wide refactoring. Inventory, which is already a prop, will be directly utilized.


**Developing Dashboard Components**

I'm now focusing on developing individual dashboard components for each role, starting with importing the necessary types and constants. For the ChefDashboard, I'll add tabs for "Live Orders" (using history) and "Menu Management." The NutritionistDashboard will filter history for food items, mapping them to "Active VIPs" using mocked data. TrainerDashboard focuses on gym inventory, the SpaDashboard has a treatment list and room status, and the ConciergeDashboard will feature a tour list and tech inventory. I will then refine the visuals, implementing a "Luxury" theme with Bento-grid styles for stats and tables for lists, while also utilizing modals for "Add/Edit" functions.


**Refining Component Implementation**

I'm now implementing Gym Inventory for Trainers, using the existing inventory prop, filtered by 'Gym'. For the Spa, I'm integrating the spaTreatments state and a room grid with status toggles. The Concierge will see tech amenities and a new "Tours" tab. Next, I will address the App.tsx integration to pass the necessary props and replace the outdated StaffView in the AdminDashboards.tsx file. I'll need to rewrite that section, focusing on breaking it into the 5 role-specific components, and I will be initializing state inside the dashboard components to make constants like MENU_ITEMS "CRUD-able".

Hapa nimeboresha mfumo wa **Operational Staff (Experts)**. Badala ya "Staff View" moja ya jumla, kila mtaalamu sasa ana **Dashboard yake maalum** iliyoundwa kulingana na majukumu yake (Chef, Nutritionist, Trainer, Spa, Concierge).

### Maboresho Yaliyofanyika:

1.  **Executive Chef Dashboard:**
    *   **Kitchen Display System (KDS):** Inaonyesha oda zinazoingia *live* na chaguo la kuzi-mark kama "Cooking" au "Ready".
    *   **Digital Menu Manager:** Anaweza kuongeza, kubadili bei, au kufuta vyakula kwenye menu.

2.  **Nutritionist Dashboard:**
    *   **VIP Guest Monitor:** Orodha ya wageni wa VIP na malengo yao ya kiafya.
    *   **Dietary Log:** Anaweza kuandika ripoti au mapendekezo ya lishe kwa kila mgeni.

3.  **Fitness Trainer Dashboard:**
